verdicts.reason: A reads clearly left to right: phone, then a one-line headline with subtitle, then badges over the CTA. Its flaws are the SOLSTICE wordmark floating on its own between the phone and the headline, a phone shrunk almost to an icon, and badges that are nearly as heavy as the CTA. B is worse. SOLSTICE is jammed against the headline and doesn't line up with its left edge. The subtitle is tiny and hard to read. The BACK BY DEMAND badge is blown up to the same size and weight as the Find It Near You button, so the badge and CTA compete. SUMMER ONLY drifts off on its own, and there is dead space between the phone and the copy.
